changes: Implemented the Authority-backed Layer 2 proof bridge path: production gate_decision receipt refs are verified/written, TEST/DONE gate consumption now enforces freshness, authority_status reports verified/eligible/consumed receipt status without claiming productionDone, and the execution plan documents proof boundaries.
usage: Use authority_receipt_verify with a production Authority gate_decision proof for a story and phase, then run lattice validate and story_advance through TEST/DONE; use authority_status to inspect receiptVerified/receiptEligible/receiptConsumed without treating the CLI as production authority.
expectedOutcome: Expected: stale or mismatched Authority receipt refs cannot unlock lifecycle gates; local diagnostic receipts and host transcripts cannot become formal proof; Layer 2 Engineering proof remains separate from Loop/Production/Capability claims.
actualTranscript: Actual: npm build passed; authority receipt proof, gate receipts, gate consumption, status, boundary, and enforce matrix smoke tests passed; Claude CLI and Codex CLI post-fix reviews both returned PASS; lattice validate --story=B-eca1 --json passed with 21/21 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No expected-vs-actual difference for this story scope; full process-fact contract still has pre-existing autopilot/release_approve_push drift unrelated to the Authority receipt path.
limitations: Authority receipt freshness is enforced as a local proof-verification freshness window; current server stateVersion checking remains conditional on a known server state version, as designed by the receipt contract.
pitfalls: Important pitfall: review_run_start outputs full ids like B-eca1:RR-007; using only RR-007 makes review_pass_set fail with unknown reviewRunId. Also refresh stale verification evidence after code commits before re-running REVIEW passes.
